provenance.purpose: First training run on the mined discordant supply. The balanced design is gated by the smallest (gold x net-sign) cell; mining lifts it from 541 to 790, so the balanced set grows 2164 -> 3160 pairs. Everything else matches the matched-compute regime in reports/BACKBONE_COMPARISON_MATCHED_COMPUTE_V1.md: 3B bf16, 4 epochs, lr 2e-5, length 1024, LoRA r=8.
provenance.cells: 790 per (gold x net-sign) cell, up from 541 in the decontaminated v2 set and 552 in the published v1 set
provenance.DECONTAMINATED: Built by the content-fingerprint filter added to scripts/build_prose_native_training_set.py. Verified 0 v4 content leaks and 0 internal content duplicates (reports/decontamination_verification.json). The published v1 sets carried 32 (seed 7) and 36 (seed 123) content twins of v4 evaluation pairs.
provenance.CONFOUND_language: The mined supply is cross-language. v2 is 100% C/C++; v3 is 69% C/C++ with 17% PHP and 14% JavaScript/Python/Java, because CrossVul's remaining discordant pairs exist only in other languages. Any movement against the published v1 numbers mixes THREE changes: decontamination, added volume, and language shift. The v2 arm is the control that separates decontamination from the rest; volume and language cannot be separated by this data.
provenance.CAVEAT_crossvul: CrossVul non-held-out pairs are training data, as in every balanced run.
